# Vendored CrowdyCPP

This directory is CrowdyCPP's source subset at the commit that `pyproject.toml`
pins under `[tool.crowdypy.crowdycpp]`. It is written by
`scripts/vendor_crowdycpp.py` and checked in CI by re-deriving it from that commit.
Do not edit it: change CrowdyCPP, release it on the same tier, and re-vendor.

Vendored from `dev/v0.75.0` (`e61ae5f1d85cbd36642103cddbb24f65a95e883e`).
